commit.message:
Register isolated ARGENTUM C4 manual compile-only preflight [skip ci]

Exactly one dispatch-only workflow addition. Implementation pinned to 33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6. Main is unprotected with no required checks or rulesets at verified readback; skip marker prevents unrelated main push CI. No production or existing workflow changes.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+name: ARGENTUM C4 cold compile only 20261015
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      approval:
+        description: Exact source-bound C4 compile-only acknowledgement
+        required: true
+        type: string
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: argentum-c4-cold-compile-only-20261015
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  cold-compile:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      max-parallel: 2
+      matrix:
+        revision: [R5, R6]
+    steps:
+      - name: Fail-closed original and approval gate before downloads
+        env:
+          APPROVAL: ${{ inputs.approval }}
+          WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = GodaPupa/argentum-batshit-test
+          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = workflow_dispatch
+          test "$GITHUB_REF" = refs/heads/infra/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015
+          test "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1/1
+          test "$WORKFLOW_REF" = GodaPupa/argentum-batshit-test/.github/workflows/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015.yml@refs/heads/infra/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015
+          test "$APPROVAL" = C4_COMPILE_ONLY_ONCE_33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/dispatch-commit.txt"
+          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/run-identity.txt"
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
+        with:
+          ref: '33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6'
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 1
+      - name: Verify pinned implementation before toolchains
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6
+          test "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')" = ed87a9c5ea6a60d968ee0856095b593a614f3816
+          cd qualification/c4-preflight
+          sha256sum -c SOURCE_SHA256SUMS
+          cp SOURCE_SHA256SUMS "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/implementation-SHA256SUMS"
+          cp "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/dispatch-event.json"
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@cf277c60eb25467037889841efdb72551f06f6c3
+        with:
+          distribution: microsoft
+          java-version: '21'
+      - name: Install exact official Just
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" https://github.com/casey/just/releases/download/1.59.0/just-1.59.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
+          echo "409044617b6f06517c1035e55ca38c8c856ff8b650e41bc2aa1ef82d5903a23e  $RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin"
+          tar --no-same-owner -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin" just
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Compile frozen variant only
+        env:
+          C4_REVISION: ${{ matrix.revision }}
+        run: python3 qualification/c4-preflight/preflight.py
+      - name: Seal complete or partial evidence
+        if: ${{ always() }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          if ! test -f result.json; then printf '%s\n' '{"status":"INCOMPLETE","reason":"preflight did not finish"}' > result.json; fi
+          find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        if: ${{ always() }}
+        with:
+          name: argentum-c4-${{ matrix.revision }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c4-evidence
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90

+# Fixed-recipient internal operation: early qualification
+
+Change exactly one authoritative occurrence while retaining original groups, divisions, visits and provenance. The original stack controller and source characteristics determine replacement legality. The accepted atomic adapter commits dependent views together. A serializable offer pins stack/recipient visits, expected plan and explicit addresses. Existing target events are emitted only for actual changes.
+
+This freezes an internal candidate and executable controls before further integration or expensive regressions. It does not establish feature, card or multiplayer acceptance. Existing public decisions do not invoke it. The subsequent coherent public-flow change must include full suspension/server/client and ward tests, all required regressions and original-artifact receiving. Existing completed receipts are reused, not re-audited.
+
+Static review: casting cardinality and original assertions are retained; shared relational checking is extracted without changing its casting order. Replacement validity does not parse diagnostic text. Only TargetValidator is modified; the accepted resolver and other 143 bindings are unchanged. The owner review is not an independent review.
+
+Known unqualified boundaries: all target-kind/source restrictions (especially departed-source player protection and supertype checks), chosen-player relational filters, repeat modes/splice, source filter trigger facts, ward processing and public choice serialization. Do not expose or register this candidate until those gates pass.
+
+The negative control deliberately recaptures a stale fixed recipient and discards original source colors. Both variants must compile; exact FM recipient-visit at line 41 and FM source-color at line 35 must fail as assertions, with zero skipped/error/unrelated failures. Restoration is byte-exact.

+"""Frozen early compiler/behavioral gate, never full feature acceptance."""
+from pathlib import Path
+from collections import Counter
+import hashlib,json,os,re,shutil,subprocess,sys
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+ROOT=Path('experiments/manual-transmission/research/fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-20261025')
+OUT=Path('manual-fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-evidence')
+P=json.loads((ROOT/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text())
+sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+git=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],text=True).strip()
+obj=lambda ref,p:subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':'+str(p)])
+SOURCE=os.environ['SOURCE']
+RESOLVER='rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/mechanics/stack/StackResolver.kt'
+
+def mutant(text):
+    for anchor,replacement in P['mutation_replacements']:
+        assert text.count(anchor)==1,anchor
+        text=text.replace(anchor,replacement,1)
+    return text
+
+def check_form(kind):
+    for path,digest in P['implementation_sha256'].items():
+        normal=obj(SOURCE,path)
+        assert sha(normal)==digest,path
+        expected=mutant(normal.decode()).encode() if kind=='mutant' and path==P['mutation_path'] else normal
+        assert Path(path).read_bytes()==expected,path
+    assert git('diff','--name-only').splitlines()==([P['mutation_path']] if kind=='mutant' else [])
+
+def bind():
+    assert git('rev-parse',SOURCE+'^{tree}')==os.environ['SOURCE_TREE']
+    assert git('rev-parse',SOURCE+'^')==P['base']
+    assert git('rev-parse','HEAD^')==SOURCE
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',SOURCE,'HEAD')==os.environ['WORKFLOW']
+    assert os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']==os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER']=='1'
+    assert git('rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main')==P['protected']['main']
+    expected=set(P['implementation_sha256'])|{str(ROOT/n) for n in ['PROTOCOL.json','DESIGN.md','gate.py']}
+    delta=[line.split('\t') for line in git('diff','--name-status',P['base'],SOURCE).splitlines()]
+    assert {row[1] for row in delta}==expected
+    assert all(len(row)==2 and row[0]==('M' if row[1] in P['modified_paths'] else 'A') for row in delta)
+    check_form('normal')
+    assert not git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no')
+    bindings=json.loads(Path('experiments/manual-transmission/research/paused-token-entry-r2-20261023/BINDINGS.json').read_text())
+    assert len(bindings)==144
+    hashes={path:spec['sha256'] for path,spec in bindings.items()}
+    hashes[RESOLVER]=P['resolver_sha256']
+    golds=json.loads(Path('experiments/manual-transmission/research/ordinary-build-r1-20261022/GOLDENS.json').read_text())
+    assert len(golds)==23 and len(P['legacy_fixture_sha256'])==82
+    hashes.update({r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in golds})
+    hashes.update(P['legacy_fixture_sha256']);hashes.update(P['recording_protected_sha256'])
+    hashes.update(P['implementation_sha256'])
+    deck='experiments/manual-transmission/control/v0.7.decklist.txt'
+    assert git('rev-parse',SOURCE+':'+deck)==P['protected']['deck_blob']
+    hashes[deck]=sha(obj(SOURCE,deck))
+    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    for path,digest in hashes.items():
+        body=Path(path).read_bytes();assert sha(body)==digest,path
+        dest=OUT/'source'/path;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_bytes(body)
+    for path in ROOT.iterdir():
+        if path.is_file():shutil.copyfile(path,OUT/path.name)
+    workflow=os.environ['WORKFLOW'];(OUT/'WORKFLOW.yml').write_bytes(Path(workflow).read_bytes())
+    (OUT/'PROTECTED.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
+    identity=dict(source=SOURCE,tree=os.environ['SOURCE_TREE'],validation=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
+        base=P['base'],workflow=workflow,workflow_blob=git('rev-parse','HEAD:'+workflow),
+        run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],attempt=1,run_number=1,delta=delta)
+    (OUT/'BINDING.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')
+    flags='--no-build-cache --no-daemon --console=plain --stacktrace --max-workers=2 -PkotlinCompileParallelism=1'
+    recipe='compile:\n    scripts/gradle-locked :rules-engine:compileKotlin :rules-engine:compileTestKotlin '+flags+'\n'
+    recipe+="targeted:\n    scripts/gradle-locked :rules-engine:test --tests '*FixedRecipientRetargetingTest' --tests '*FixedRecipientMutationWitnessTest' "+flags+'\n'
+    recipe+="mutation:\n    scripts/gradle-locked :rules-engine:test --tests '*FixedRecipientMutationWitnessTest' "+flags+'\n'
+    (OUT/'validation.just').write_text(recipe)
+
+def restore():
+    for path in P['implementation_sha256']:Path(path).write_bytes(obj(SOURCE,path))
+    check_form('normal')
+
+def reports():
+    return [p for p in Path('.').glob('**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml') if OUT.name not in p.parts]
+
+def prepare(stage):
+    out=OUT/stage;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    prior=[]
+    for p in reports():prior.append(dict(path=str(p),sha256=sha(p.read_bytes())));p.unlink()
+    (out/'DELETED_PRIOR_REPORTS.json').write_text(json.dumps(prior,indent=2)+'\n')
+    kind='mutant' if stage in ['compile-mutant','mutation'] else 'normal'
+    if kind=='mutant':Path(P['mutation_path']).write_text(mutant(obj(SOURCE,P['mutation_path']).decode()))
+    check_form(kind)
+    (out/'SOURCE.diff').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff']))
+    for path in P['implementation_sha256']:
+        dest=out/'source'/path;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_bytes(Path(path).read_bytes())
+    assert not reports()
+
+def receive(stage):
+    out=OUT/stage;rc=int((out/'exit.txt').read_text());log=(out/'gradle.log').read_text()
+    kind='mutant' if stage in ['compile-mutant','mutation'] else 'normal';check_form(kind)
+    assert not re.search(r'^e: |^> Task .*:compile\S* FAILED$|Compilation error|Unresolved reference',log,re.M)
+    if stage.startswith('compile-'):
+        assert rc==0 and 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' in log and not reports()
+        assert re.search(r'^> Task :rules-engine:compileKotlin$',log,re.M)
+        assert re.search(r'^> Task :rules-engine:compileTestKotlin(?: UP-TO-DATE)?$',log,re.M)
+        assert not re.search(r'^> Task :rules-engine:test(?: |$)',log,re.M)
+        result=dict(stage=stage,compile=True,tests=0)
+    else:
+        cases=[];failures=[];errors=[];skips=[]
+        for path in reports():
+            assert str(path).startswith('rules-engine/build/test-results/test/'),path
+            dest=out/'junit'/path;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(path,dest)
+            suite=ET.fromstring(path.read_bytes());rows=suite.findall('.//testcase')
+            assert int(suite.get('tests'))==len(rows)
+            for attr,tag in [('failures','failure'),('errors','error'),('skipped','skipped')]:
+                assert int(suite.get(attr))==sum(r.find(tag) is not None for r in rows)
+            for row in rows:
+                identity=row.get('classname')+'::'+row.get('name');cases.append(identity)
+                if row.find('error') is not None:errors.append(identity)
+                if row.find('skipped') is not None:skips.append(identity)
+                f=row.find('failure')
+                if f is not None:failures.append(dict(identity=identity,type=f.get('type'),stack=f.text or ''))
+        result=dict(stage=stage,cases=sorted(cases),failures=failures,errors=errors,skips=skips,exit=rc)
+        (out/'SUMMARY.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
+        assert len(cases)==len(set(cases)) and not errors and not skips
+        if stage=='mutation':
+            assert rc!=0 and sorted(cases)==sorted(P['negative_first_frames'])
+            assert {f['identity'] for f in failures}==set(P['negative_first_frames'])
+            assert re.findall(r'^> Task (\S+) FAILED$',log,re.M)==[':rules-engine:test']
+            for f in failures:
+                assert f['type']=='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError'
+                frame=re.search(r'FixedRecipientMutationWitnessTest\.kt:(\d+)',f['stack'])
+                assert frame and int(frame.group(1))==P['negative_first_frames'][f['identity']]
+        else:
+            assert rc==0 and not failures and sorted(cases)==P['positive_cases']
+            assert re.search(r'^> Task :rules-engine:test$',log,re.M)
+    (out/'RECEIPT.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
+
+def manifest():
+    files={str(p.relative_to(OUT)):sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in OUT.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name!='MANIFEST.json'}
+    (OUT/'MANIFEST.json').write_text(json.dumps(files,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
+
+mode=sys.argv[1]
+if mode=='bind':bind()
+elif mode=='restore':restore()
+elif mode=='prepare':prepare(sys.argv[2])
+elif mode=='receive':receive(sys.argv[2])
+elif mode=='manifest':manifest()
+else:raise SystemExit('Unknown mode')

+/** Server-authored occurrence menu. A response chooses an address, never a flattened target. */
+@Serializable
+internal data class FixedRecipientOffer(
+    val stackRef: ObjectRef,
+    val expected: CurrentTargetPlan,
+    val recipient: ChosenTarget,
+    val recipientRef: ObjectRef?,
+    val chooserId: EntityId,
+    val addresses: List<TargetSlotAddress>,
+)
+
+/** One existing authoritative occurrence is changed; no original declaration is reconstructed. */
+internal object FixedRecipientRetargeting {
+    private val validator = TargetValidator()
+
+    fun offer(state: GameState, stackId: EntityId, recipient: ChosenTarget, chooserId: EntityId): FixedRecipientOffer? {
+        val ref = state.objectRef(stackId) ?: return null
+        val container = state.getEntity(stackId) ?: return null
+        val plan = container.currentTargetPlan() ?: return null
+        if (stackId !in state.stack || !plan.isCoherent(container)) return null
+        val recipientRef = if (recipient is ChosenTarget.Player) null else state.objectRef(targetEntityId(recipient)) ?: return null
+        val offer = FixedRecipientOffer(ref, plan, recipient, recipientRef, chooserId, plan.selections.addresses())
+        val addresses = offer.addresses.filter { replacement(state, offer, it) != null }
+        return offer.copy(addresses = addresses).takeIf { addresses.isNotEmpty() }
+    }
+
+    fun apply(state: GameState, offer: FixedRecipientOffer, address: TargetSlotAddress): EffectResult {
+        val replacement = replacement(state, offer, address) ?: return EffectResult.success(state)
+        val stackId = offer.stackRef.entityId
+        val container = state.getEntity(stackId) ?: return EffectResult.success(state)
+        val context = context(state, stackId) ?: return EffectResult.success(state)
+        val updated = container.withCurrentTargetPlan(offer.expected, replacement) ?: return EffectResult.success(state)
+        var result = state.withEntity(stackId, updated)
+        val sourceName = container.get<CardComponent>()?.name
+            ?: container.get<TriggeredAbilityOnStackComponent>()?.sourceName
+            ?: container.get<ActivatedAbilityOnStackComponent>()?.sourceName ?: "Ability"
+        val events = mutableListOf<GameEvent>(TargetsChosenEvent(offer.chooserId, stackId, sourceName))
+        val recipientSlot = replacement.selections.slot(address)
+        // Being targeted a second time by the same stack object is not newly becoming its target.
+        val alreadyTargeted = offer.expected.slots.any { it.sameRulesObjectAs(recipientSlot) }
+        if (!alreadyTargeted && offer.recipient !is ChosenTarget.Card) {
+            val targetId = targetEntityId(offer.recipient)
+            val entity = result.getEntity(targetId)
+            val tracking = entity?.get<TargetedByControllerThisTurnComponent>() ?: TargetedByControllerThisTurnComponent()
+            val isSpell = offer.recipient is ChosenTarget.Spell
+            val isPlayer = offer.recipient is ChosenTarget.Player
+            events.add(BecomesTargetEvent(targetId,
+                if (isPlayer) entity?.get<PlayerComponent>()?.name ?: "Player" else entity?.get<CardComponent>()?.name ?: "Object",
+                stackId, context.controller, isSpell || !tracking.hasBeenTargetedBy(context.controller),
+                targetIsSpell = isSpell, sourceIsSpell = context.kind == TargetingSourceType.SPELL, targetIsPlayer = isPlayer))
+            if (!isSpell) result = result.updateEntity(targetId) { it.with(tracking.withController(context.controller)) }
+        }
+        return EffectResult.success(result, events)
+    }
+
+    private fun replacement(state: GameState, offer: FixedRecipientOffer, address: TargetSlotAddress): CurrentTargetPlan? {
+        val stackId = offer.stackRef.entityId
+        if (stackId !in state.stack || !state.isCurrentObject(offer.stackRef) || address !in offer.addresses) return null
+        val container = state.getEntity(stackId) ?: return null
+        if (container.currentTargetPlan() != offer.expected || !offer.expected.isCoherent(container)) return null
+        if (offer.recipient is ChosenTarget.Player) {
+            if (offer.recipientRef != null || state.getEntity(offer.recipient.playerId)?.get<PlayerComponent>() == null) return null
+        } else if (offer.recipientRef == null || offer.recipientRef.entityId != targetEntityId(offer.recipient) ||
+            !state.isCurrentObject(offer.recipientRef)) return null
+        if (targetEntityId(offer.recipient) == stackId) return null
+        if (address !in offer.expected.selections.addresses()) return null
+        val selection = offer.expected.selections.replacingRecipient(address, offer.recipient, offer.recipientRef) ?: return null
+        if (selection == offer.expected.selections) return null
+        val context = context(state, stackId) ?: return null
+        val requirements = container.get<TargetsComponent>()?.targetRequirements ?: return null
+        if (!validator.replacementIsLegal(state, offer.expected.selections, selection, address, requirements,
+                context.controller, context.sourceId, context.colors, context.subtypes, context.cardTypes, context.kind, context.xValue)) return null
+        val replacement = offer.expected.copy(selections = selection)
+        // The accepted atomic adapter also checks legacy mode/division representations.
+        if (container.withCurrentTargetPlan(offer.expected, replacement) == null) return null
+        return replacement
+    }
+
+    private data class Context(
+        val controller: EntityId, val sourceId: EntityId, val kind: TargetingSourceType,
+        val colors: Set<Color>, val subtypes: Set<String>, val cardTypes: Set<String>, val xValue: Int?,
+    )
+
+    private fun context(state: GameState, stackId: EntityId): Context? {
+        val entity = state.getEntity(stackId) ?: return null
+        entity.get<SpellOnStackComponent>()?.let { spell ->
+            val card = entity.get<CardComponent>() ?: return null
+            return Context(entity.get<ControllerComponent>()?.playerId ?: spell.casterId, stackId, TargetingSourceType.SPELL,
+                card.colors, card.typeLine.subtypes.map { it.value }.toSet(), card.typeLine.cardTypes.map { it.name }.toSet(), spell.xValue)
+        }
+        entity.get<TriggeredAbilityOnStackComponent>()?.let { ability ->
+            val source = AbilitySourceCharacteristics.resolve(state, ability.sourceId, ability.objectReferences,
+                ability.sourceBattlefieldTimestamp, ability.lastKnownSourceSnapshot)
+            return Context(ability.controllerId, ability.sourceId, TargetingSourceType.ABILITY,
+                source.colors, source.subtypes, source.cardTypes, ability.xValue)
+        }
+        entity.get<ActivatedAbilityOnStackComponent>()?.let { ability ->
+            val source = AbilitySourceCharacteristics.resolve(state, ability.sourceId, ability.objectReferences,
+                ability.sourceBattlefieldTimestamp, ability.lastKnownSourceSnapshot)
+            return Context(ability.controllerId, ability.sourceId, TargetingSourceType.ABILITY,
+                source.colors, source.subtypes, source.cardTypes, ability.xValue)
+        }
+        return null
+    }
+}

+package com.wingedsheep.engine.scenarios
+
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.handlers.*
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.mechanics.layers.*
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.mechanics.stack.StackResolver
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.mechanics.targeting.*
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.state.components.stack.*
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.support.ScenarioTestBase
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.dsl.Effects
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.dsl.Targets
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.scripting.Duration
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.scripting.targets.EffectTarget
+import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
+
+class FixedRecipientMutationWitnessTest : ScenarioTestBase() {
+    init {
+        for (axis in listOf("recipient-visit", "source-color")) test("FM $axis") {
+            val game = scenario().withPlayers("One", "Two").withCardOnBattlefield(1, "Hill Giant")
+                .withCardOnBattlefield(1, "Grizzly Bears").withCardOnBattlefield(2, "Craw Wurm").build()
+            val source = game.findPermanent("Hill Giant")!!
+            val old = game.findPermanent("Grizzly Bears")!!
+            val recipient = game.findPermanent("Craw Wurm")!!
+            val plan = CurrentTargetPlan(TargetSlotPlan(listOf(TargetInstanceSelection(listOf(
+                TargetSlot(ChosenTarget.Permanent(old), game.state.objectRef(old)))))))
+            val origin = game.state.objectRef(source)!!
+            val queued = StackResolver(cardRegistry).putTriggeredAbility(game.state,
+                TriggeredAbilityOnStackComponent(source, "Hill Giant", game.player1Id, Effects.Destroy(EffectTarget.ContextTarget(0)), "Witness",
+                    objectReferences = ObjectReferenceEnvironment(captured = true, origin = origin, source = origin), originalTargetSlots = plan.selections),
+                plan.targets, listOf(Targets.Creature), currentTargetPlan = plan)
+            queued.error shouldBe null
+            val id = queued.state.stack.last()
+            if (axis == "source-color") {
+                val state = queued.state.addFloatingEffect(Layer.ABILITY, SerializableModification.GrantKeyword("PROTECTION_FROM_RED"),
+                    setOf(recipient), Duration.EndOfTurn, EffectContext(sourceId = source, controllerId = game.player1Id))
+                FixedRecipientRetargeting.offer(state, id, ChosenTarget.Permanent(recipient), game.player2Id) shouldBe null
+            } else {
+                val offer = requireNotNull(FixedRecipientRetargeting.offer(queued.state, id, ChosenTarget.Permanent(recipient), game.player2Id))
+                val identity = queued.state.objectIdentities.getValue(recipient)
+                val state = queued.state.copy(objectIdentities = queued.state.objectIdentities + (recipient to identity.copy(generation = identity.generation + 1)))
+                val result = FixedRecipientRetargeting.apply(state, offer, offer.addresses.single())
+                result.state shouldBe state
+                result.events shouldBe emptyList()
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+name: Manual fixed recipient preflight R1
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [validation/manual-fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-20261025]
+    paths: ['.github/workflows/manual-fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-20261025.yml']
+permissions: {contents: read}
+concurrency:
+  group: manual-transmission-engine-qualification
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+env:
+  SOURCE: 388f6156ac726c17fd591a87ffbee1bb7224c170
+  SOURCE_TREE: ac74d8b6580acdda679816b7b6269ea99ca7c1d3
+  WORKFLOW: .github/workflows/manual-fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-20261025.yml
+  RECORD: experiments/manual-transmission/research/fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-20261025
+  EVIDENCE: manual-fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-evidence
+  GRADLE_OPTS: -Dorg.gradle.daemon=false
+  GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    if: github.run_number == 1 && github.run_attempt == 1
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 60
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with: {distribution: temurin, java-version: '21'}
+      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+      - name: Install approved locked recipe runner
+        run: |
+          sudo apt-get update
+          sudo apt-get install -y just
+          command -v flock
+          mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/argentum" "$EVIDENCE"
+      - name: Bind frozen candidate and all protected evidence
+        run: python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" bind
+      - name: Compile normal and mutant before executable controls
+        run: |
+          for variant in normal mutant; do
+            python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" restore
+            python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" prepare "compile-$variant"
+            set +e
+            flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" just --working-directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --justfile "$EVIDENCE/validation.just" compile 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/compile-$variant/gradle.log"
+            rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+            set -e
+            printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/compile-$variant/exit.txt"
+            python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" receive "compile-$variant"
+          done
+      - name: Restore after compilation
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" restore
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" bind
+      - name: Execute 42 normal cases and two exact negative witnesses
+        run: |
+          for stage in targeted mutation; do
+            python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" restore
+            python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" prepare "$stage"
+            set +e
+            flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" just --working-directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --justfile "$EVIDENCE/validation.just" "$stage" 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/$stage/gradle.log"
+            rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+            set -e
+            printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/$stage/exit.txt"
+            python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" receive "$stage"
+          done
+      - name: Restore and rebind original candidate
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" restore
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" bind
+      - name: Reexecute restored 42 cases
+        run: |
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" prepare restored
+          set +e
+          flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" just --working-directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --justfile "$EVIDENCE/validation.just" targeted 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/restored/gradle.log"
+          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          set -e
+          printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/restored/exit.txt"
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" receive restored
+      - name: Archive complete original evidence
+        if: always()
+        run: python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" manifest
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: manual-fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: manual-fixed-recipient-preflight-r1-evidence
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
